request.query: Bezout identity finite family gcd is a linear combination

items.name: exists_gcd_eq_mul_add_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [IsDomain R] [inst_3 : GCDMonoid R] (a b : R),
  ∃ x y, gcd a b = a * x + b * y

items.name: Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab
items.type: ∀ (x y : ℤ), ↑(x.gcd y) = x * x.gcdA y + y * x.gcdB y

items.name: gcd_dvd_iff_exists
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [IsDomain R] [inst_3 : GCDMonoid R] (a b : R) {z : R},
  gcd a b ∣ z ↔ ∃ x y, z = a * x + b * y

items.name: IsBezout.gcd_eq_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] (x y : R) [inst_1 : Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.span {x, y})],
  ∃ a b, a * x + b * y = IsBezout.gcd x y

items.name: EuclideanDomain.gcd_eq_gcd_ab
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : EuclideanDomain R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq R] (a b : R),
  EuclideanDomain.gcd a b = a * EuclideanDomain.gcdA a b + b * EuclideanDomain.gcdB a b

items.name: Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab
items.type: ∀ (x y : ℕ), ↑(x.gcd y) = ↑x * x.gcdA y + ↑y * x.gcdB y

items.name: IsBezout.gcd
items.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : Ring R] → (x y : R) → [Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.span {x, y})] → R

items.name: PNat.gcd_b_eq
items.type: ∀ (a b : ℕ+), b = a.gcdB' b * a.gcd b
